description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Hon. Ministers Hon. T. J.  Marapana Hon (Mrs.) Thalatha Athukorala, Hon. M. G. Jayawickrema Perera with effect from 25.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (Hon. Thilak Janaka Marapana, MP; Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Athukorala, MP; Hon. Mallawaarachchige Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, MP) AND their detailed ministerial portfolios (Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister of Justice, Minister of Buddhasasana). This combination of "who" (named government personnel) and "what" (specific portfolio responsibilities) meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
